title: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital kills at least six, Gaza civil defence says
detail: An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed at least six people, according to Gaza's civil defence agency. Casualty figures are as reported by the civil defence agency and not independently verified; Israeli response not yet captured.

title: Israel kills 10 Palestinians in Gaza since dawn after two hospitals struck
detail: Middle East Eye's live blog reports Israeli attacks killed 10 Palestinians across Gaza since dawn on Nov 12, following strikes on two hospitals. Figures are as reported by the outlet and not independently verified; Israeli comment not captured.
